normative_extracts.quote: Before sending a non-simple cross-origin request, the user agent issues an OPTIONS preflight carrying Access-Control-Request-Method and Access-Control-Request-Headers.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The Fetch layer gates cross-origin reads behind server-returned Access-Control-Allow-* headers and restricts cross-site cookie attachment via SameSite attributes.

production_failures.symptom: Every authenticated API call incurs a 2x latency penalty from repeated OPTIONS preflights
production_failures.root_cause: Sending custom headers (Authorization, Content-Type: application/json) without Access-Control-Max-Age on the server forces an OPTIONS round-trip on every request.
production_failures.mitigation: Return Access-Control-Max-Age: 86400 (capped at 7200s in Chromium, 86400s in Firefox) on OPTIONS responses.

production_failures.symptom: Session cookies silently omitted on cross-site OAuth redirect or embedded widget fetch
production_failures.root_cause: Cookies without SameSite=None; Secure default to SameSite=Lax, which strips cookies from cross-site POSTs and subresource fetches.
production_failures.mitigation: Set SameSite=Lax for first-party sessions, or SameSite=None; Secure for intentional cross-site embedded APIs, paired with CSRF tokens.
